channel.title: WebToolNest Blog
channel.description: Practical how-to guides and answers from WebToolNest: speeches, typing, contacts, Instagram, gaming controllers, Discord and more — each with a free tool to do the job.

item.title: Discord Timestamps: How to Show a Time in Everyone's Time Zone
item.description: Discord timestamps like <t:1767225600:F> show every member an event time in their own time zone. All 7 formats with examples, and how to make one in seconds.

item.title: How Many Words Is a 5-Minute Speech? (Chart for 1 to 60 Minutes)
item.description: A 5-minute speech is about 650 words at an average pace of 130 words per minute. See a chart for 1–60 minute speeches, common speech lengths and how to time yours.

item.title: How to Import Contacts From Excel to iPhone, Android or Gmail
item.description: Turn an Excel or CSV list of names and phone numbers into phone contacts: convert it to a VCF file, then import it on iPhone, Android or Google Contacts.

item.title: How to See Who Unfollowed You on Instagram (Free, No App)
item.description: See who doesn't follow you back on Instagram using Instagram's own data download — no password and no risky follower apps. Step-by-step for iPhone, Android and computer.

item.title: Stick Drift: How to Test It and Fix It (PS5, Xbox, Switch and PC)
item.description: Is your controller drifting? Test both sticks in your browser in 5 seconds, learn what causes stick drift, and try the fixes that work — from calibration and deadzones to cleaning and repair.

item.title: What Is a Good Typing Speed? Average WPM, Job Requirements and How to Improve
item.description: A good typing speed is about 50–70 words per minute with 95%+ accuracy. See the average WPM, what speed different jobs ask for, and practical ways to type faster.
